text:
Sarah CSM: Heads up — Sandstone asked for a quick weekend bootcamp to onboard their APAC teams before their renewal call on Monday. Renewal flagged as "watch"; they want a hands-on primer (2h) + Q&A. Can we patch a host for Sat 09:00–11:00 UTC (Sun 17:00–19:00 AEST)?
James Enablement: I can host the primer but might not be available for the Q&A window. Happy to run the first 90m demo + walkthrough.
Maria Ops: @James Enablement — would you be ok with @Ollie Support covering the last 30m Q&A and follow-ups? Ollie can handle infra/accounting questions.
Ollie Support: Yep I can take the back half. Need the runbook + a list of customer environments and read-only creds to repro issues.
Sarah CSM: Perfect. I'll drop the minimal pre-read and guest accounts now. Link: https://redwood.infra/sandstone/pre-read — includes test creds and a short checklist.
Linda Product: Can we include a short 10-min segment on the latest latency/cost improvements? Sandstone asked about token pricing and Dedicated slots. I can do that at +30m mark.
James Enablement: Agenda draft:```
00:00 - 10m - Welcome + goals (Sarah)
10:00 - 40m - Product update + billing note (Linda)
40:00 - 1:40 - Hands-on demo: API quickstart + common gotchas (James)
1:40 - 2:00 - Q&A + next steps (Ollie)
```
Maria Ops: Logistics: calendar invite, Zoom link, and recording enabled. Who creates the invite?
Sarah CSM: I'll create the invite and mark as private. Adding calendar-bot to auto-post reminders.
calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: Sandstone Bootcamp — Sat 09:00 UTC. Reminders: 24h and 1h before.
Ollie Support: Quick ask — can someone confirm sample data is on staging? The pre-read creds looked like prod. I don't want to risk touching prod during demo.
Sarah CSM: Good catch. Swapped to staging creds and rotated token. New link is the same URL.
James Enablement: Please add a short troubleshooting cheat-sheet into the invite notes (3 commands/snippets). I'll paste mine here:```bash
# fetch example convo
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -d '<PAYLOAD>'
```
Linda Product: Also add a slide with renewal checklist: usage trends, forecast, suggested Dedicated offset. Keep it to one slide.
Maria Ops: Who owns post-session follow-up and the action tracker? I can make a shared doc if someone confirms owner.
Sarah CSM: I'll own follow-ups and open the tracker. @Maria Ops please set up the doc and add actions during session.
Ollie Support: Sandstone asked if we can provide a short eval suite they can run against their prompts to show quality baseline. Any templated test?
James Enablement: We have a 5-check eval harness; I'll attach it to the invite and demo how to run it.
Sarah CSM: Final checklist before invite: host (James), backup host (Ollie), product segment (Linda), pre-read link, staging creds confirmed, calendar+zoom, recording on, follow-up doc (Maria). Everyone ok?
Linda Product: ✅
Ollie Support: ✅
James Enablement: ✅ — note: if session runs late I may drop at +2h10. Ollie can field overflow.
Maria Ops: ✅ doc will be ready; sharing link in thread once done.
Sarah CSM: Sending invite now. If anyone needs to swap, tell me within 2 hours. Thanks all :thumbsup:
calendar-bot: Event created and shared with participants.
Sarah CSM: Invite sent — attendees + Sandstone CSMs included. Post-session tasks: 1) upload recording, 2) populate action tracker, 3) renewal health flag update. I'll mark renewal as 'watch' and escalate to AM if no usage lift in 72h.
James Enablement: I'll attach the eval harness to the recording and point to the dedicated recommendation template.
Maria Ops: Doc link: https://docs.redwood.com/sandstone/bootcamp-actions (edit perms to team).
Ollie Support: All set on my side. Ready to field Qs and take notes.
Sarah CSM: Thanks team — let's make this a smooth handoff and try to turn this into a renewal win. :rocket:
